sourceReferences.supports: Который agrees in gender and number with its antecedent, while its case is selected by its syntactic function within the relative clause. The dative forms of который are которому (masculine/neuter singular), которой (feminine singular), and которым (plural). The provided examples apply dative government inside the relative clause: помогать/помочь кому, позвонить кому, and дать кому.
